# Liu, Wang, and Luo (2026) behavioral source data

These are unmodified public trial-level files from the OSF project associated
with:

> Liu D, Wang M, Luo H. Human brains construct individualized global rankings
> from identical few-shot learning input. PLOS Biology 24(4):e3003756 (2026).
> https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3003756

Source project: https://osf.io/gya95/

The first file contains 40 participants. The second contains the 37 retained
replication participants after the source study's below-chance exclusion. Each
retained participant has 280 query trials: all 28 pairs repeated in 10 blocks.

No inferred or processed values should be written into this directory. Derived
runtime outputs belong under `artifacts/runs/`; registered contracts and compact
evidence belong to their owning `studies/<study-id>/records/` directory and must
retain these source hashes.
